summary: Compute a floored poloidal-field magnitude and its median reference value from BR and BZ arrays.

capability: Compute a floored poloidal-field magnitude and its median reference value from BR and BZ arrays.
operation: pointwise Euclidean magnitude with a finite lower floor
radial and axial field arrays -> B and B0_default
discovery.model: Pointwise Euclidean magnitude with a finite lower floor.
discovery.boundary: Nonfinite inputs, shape mismatch, empty arrays and unrepresentable magnitudes are rejected.

identity.direction: radial and axial field arrays to B and B0_default
identity.definition: Compute hypot(BR,BZ), floor each entry at 1e-30, and return the median using a difference-first midpoint.
identity.model: Pointwise Euclidean magnitude with a finite lower floor.
identity.boundary: Nonfinite inputs, shape mismatch, empty arrays, and unrepresentable magnitudes are rejected.
assumptions: Inputs are finite real arrays with identical 2-D shape.
The reference is a descriptive median, not an automatically applied normalization.
The floor is part of the numerical contract.

inputs.name: br
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonempty two-dimensional array; same shape as bz.

inputs.name: bz
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonempty two-dimensional array; same shape as br.

outputs.name: B
outputs.constraints: Finite and at least 1e-30 T for accepted inputs whose magnitude fits float64.

outputs.name: B0_default
outputs.description: Median of the returned B values for use as a caller-selected reference field.
outputs.constraints: Finite, at least 1e-30 T, and derived from all returned grid values.

preconditions: Inputs are finite real arrays with identical 2-D shape.
The reference is a descriptive median, not an automatically applied normalization.
supported: Zero floor, large finite values, shape failures, and median reference behavior.
excluded: Vector fields of other rank, automatic normalization, and physical field-quality assessment.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for nonfinite, empty, non-2-D, mismatched, or unrepresentable inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: No iterative runtime failure is defined; overflow is converted to ValueError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; magnitude and median are direct operations.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No mapping is returned after validation or overflow failure.

example.description: Compute the magnitude for a 3-4-5 point and a zero pair.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field import compute_poloidal_field_magnitude
result = compute_poloidal_field_magnitude([[3.0, 0.0]], [[4.0, 0.0]])
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['B'], [[5.0, 1e-30]])
assert result['B0_default'] == 2.5
example.expected: B is [[5,1e-30]] T and B0_default is 2.5 T.

scope: 3-4-5 magnitude, zero floor and median reference.
Shape mismatch, empty grid and unrepresentable magnitude rejection.
Large finite component and median arithmetic regressions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests cover the arithmetic and selected floating-point boundaries of this maintained relation; they do not establish a model-specific physical interpretation of the reference median or expert recognition of the development record.
known_limitations: The returned median is a default numerical reference, not an independently determined physical scale.
The fixed floor replaces exact zero in B.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.
